title: GraphQL Ownership And Connection Types
description: Add ownership unions and Relay-style connection types to all entities in compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql; complete EntityConnection union.
summary: Completed Connector ↔ Port alignment with target SDL: (1) target.schema.graphql — merged PortConnection / PortDiffConnection / PortDiffsConnection / PortModificationConnection into both EntityConnection aggregate unions (they previously skipped from Point→Position). Modification/DiffOwned/DiffsOwned/OwnerEntity/AggregateEntityEdge already included Port* variants. (2) compose/rs/lib.rs — added GraphQL Port object (id, hash, owner Type, code, label, order), Type.ports storage + port_by_id lookup; Connector exposes port: Port via port_id → owning Type instead of portId scalar; connection Side.port now references Weak<Port> (was Connector). Extended parses_target_schema to assert type Connector and type Port in emitted SDL. cargo test (compose crate) passes.
